Herpesviridae is recognized by a variety of PRRs and the innate immune response can be activated by agonists for these receptors.
the host immune system is capable of detecting HSV2 and HCV infection through different PRRs, which can be targeted to develop a more effective treatment.
the innate immune system is capable of recognizing HSV2 and HMCV infection and it can be used as a therapeutic approach for these viruses.

the innate immune system can be a good therapeutic target to treat Herpes virus infection.
different PRR agonists can be used as prophylaxis to prevent Herpes virus infection.
